# ONNX Runtime release notices

These are unmodified upstream `v1.23.2` license/notice files from the official Microsoft
ONNX Runtime repository, matching the pinned browser runtime. The npm distribution used by
MeshLens omits these files, so the project keeps version-matched copies for static builds.
`provenance.json` records source URLs, byte counts and SHA256 digests.

The MIT license applies to ONNX Runtime itself; the complete upstream third-party notice
file retains the separate terms and attribution for its components. Keeping this upstream
notice set does not assert that every listed optional component is in the browser build.
